atyr_reverse_split_alias.defect: Reverse-split alias missing: a ticker renamed by a reverse split resolves to nothing.

ibkr_total_cash_loan_dropped.defect: IBKR total-cash loan dropped by the leverage disclosure (E8).

d8_publication_check_never_passes.defect: D8 publication-state check can never pass for a committed release.

robuxio_gross_net_splice.defect: Robuxio hybrid line joins a GROSS backtest to a NET live path.

grizzlybears_3x_replica_scale.defect: GrizzlyBears 3x replica shown with no scale warning.

matrixport_gap_days.defect: Matrixport gap days not accounted for in the return chain.

validator_fixture_values_no_builder_emit.defect: Validator fixtures carry values no builder ever emits, so a check passes on fixtures and fails on real output.

scratch_path_sidecar_read.defect: A sidecar is read from a scratch path instead of the hashed input.

ci_reports_every_failure.defect: CI test step stopped at the first failure (maxfail=1) and hid the rest (#910).
ci_reports_every_failure.kill: pyproject addopts contains --maxfail=1 on the pre-fix tree, so the assertion fails.

portfolio_twr_no_annual_rate.defect: Portfolio TWR published only as a cumulative figure beside an annual MWR (#904 item 1).
portfolio_twr_no_annual_rate.kill: Pre-fix build_portfolio_twr has no annualised_act_365 / trailing_12_months / year_to_date keys, so the lookup raises KeyError.

short_window_account_cagr.defect: Account CAGR published for a window under 365 days (#904 items 2-3).
short_window_account_cagr.kill: Pre-fix _strategy_period_fields publishes account_live_cagr for 210 days; the status is not SUPPRESSED_UNDER_365D.

sleeve_rate_short_window.defect: Sleeve return per year published from a 280-day window (#904 items 3-4).
sleeve_rate_short_window.kill: Pre-fix _annualise returns a number for 280 days.

ronc_linear_short_window.defect: Return on net capital scaled linearly under a year and geometrically above (#904 item 5).
ronc_linear_short_window.kill: Pre-fix 40-day RONC of 2.44% is 22.27% (linear) instead of the geometric ACT/365 figure.

mwr_short_window_not_primary.defect: Money-weighted XIRR shown as the headline for a window under a year (#904 item 4).
mwr_short_window_not_primary.kill: Pre-fix app.js has no mwrShortWindow rule, so the assertion fails.

calendar_series_scaled_with_252.defect: Calendar-daily series annualised with 252 periods a year (#904 item 6).
calendar_series_scaled_with_252.kill: Pre-fix attribution scales a 7-day-a-week series with the declared 252.

reconciliation_tracking_error_252.defect: Reconciliation tracking error scaled with a hard-coded 252 on any calendar (#904 item 7).
reconciliation_tracking_error_252.kill: Pre-fix tracking error equals stdev * sqrt(252) for a calendar-daily series, not sqrt(365).

dependence_summary_day_count.defect: Dependence summary annualised on 365.25 days and one period short (#904 item 8).
dependence_summary_day_count.kill: Pre-fix window is first-to-last row (365 days) and uses a 365.25 exponent, so window_days and cagr differ.

accepted_spans_omitted_from_dependence.defect: Robuxio accepted multi-day return spans omitted from the dependence summary (#904 item 9).
accepted_spans_omitted_from_dependence.kill: Pre-fix _performance_summary takes no spans, so the call raises TypeError and the cumulative return is the daily rows alone.

hybrid_cagr_published.defect: CAGR published on a hybrid series that is mostly vendor backtest (#904 item 10).
hybrid_cagr_published.kill: Pre-fix a series with backtest observations still carries a cagr value.

alpha_headline_without_standard_error.defect: Alpha tile published as a headline with no standard error, or on a backtest-dominated fit (#904 item 11).
alpha_headline_without_standard_error.kill: Pre-fix _alpha_context has no headline_status key, so the lookup raises KeyError.

epoch_table_shared_end_date.defect: Epoch table printed every figure against one shared end date (#904 item 12).
epoch_table_shared_end_date.kill: Pre-fix app.js has no per-figure window note (ownWindowNote).

tracking_error_population_std.defect: Tracking error computed with the population standard deviation and unlabelled (#904 item 13).
tracking_error_population_std.kill: Pre-fix portfolio_target_series uses pstdev for the tracking error, so the source assertion fails.
